backup.production_rule: Everyone adds a new inventory item with Undo (Lloyd 2026-11-19, D-386, contract docs/s125/CONTRACT-add-item.md L1 SQL). inventory_item_changes.kind check gains created. Replaces four live bodies in place, each behind an md5 guard (CR stripped, 55000 when the live body is neither the original nor this release): inventory_item_create_v1 (original 30170851aad1418e0ec7b104ba6842d3, new 697d8c65fc38aebdf2d3e199e8437013; a cleaner with submit_cleaning adds name, category (one already in use), unit, consumable, reorder_below, qty, location, any other key or p_code 42501; owner/admin gain location; writes updated_by / updated_at and one created change row with no price; return adds change_id), inventory_item_change_undo_v1 (original ad1665a60b979918ecb0260e1227137a, new 86d7879703760fdc90e6b455e33bdacd; kind created sets is_active false, refused changed_since after a newer change row other than the same person's photo, any stock movement besides the first count written in the create's own transaction, any item move, or a usage row, purchase, Telegram count or foreign barcode after the add), get_inventory_catalogue_v1 (original 2b07eed9209ccb4fe09836e30bf52999, new 6832ffc21ce22a01f591cbcf03f42497; adds updatedKind), inventory_option_request_v1 (original 5c0fdd0dd45e331ae643300805226a86, new e7f4509fc1515d0e2325034a6375669e; a non-manager add on an item they created under 30 minutes ago and did not undo applies at once, up to 3 products on the item). inventory_item_history_v1 is NOT replaced (its s124 body already returns a created row as kind created with empty fields). Grants restated for every function (revoke from public, anon, authenticated, service_role; grant execute to authenticated). Requires the s124 release applied first (its md5 guard on the catalogue and undo bodies).
backup.notes: The restore point is the backup taken for the rehearsal; restamp it with a new backup at apply time (the checker refuses one older than an hour). Apply AFTER the s124 release. Roll the staff app back before the SQL.

forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.inventory_item_changes'::regclass and conname = 'inventory_item_changes_kind_check' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%''created''%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%''details''%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%''price''%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%''photo''%')

rollback.safe_until: Always: created change rows are deleted by design (the items stay, they lose their Undo); the four bodies and the kind check go back.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261125_s125_add_item.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; the four bodies must be back to md5 30170851aad1418e0ec7b104ba6842d3, ad1665a60b979918ecb0260e1227137a, 2b07eed9209ccb4fe09836e30bf52999, 5c0fdd0dd45e331ae643300805226a86. Roll the staff app back first.

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_app_follows_the_sql
feature_flags.required_state: None. Old staff builds keep working: every existing key of every return stays; change_id on create and updatedKind on the catalogue are additions an old build ignores. A cleaner can add an item only through the new staff build.
